mechanism: The logical act of proving a {{hypothesis}} false by {{observe}}ing an {{incongruity}} between prediction and observation. It creates specific knowledge by eliminating possibilities.
invariants: Modus tollens: prediction implies observation; observation fails; therefore not the {{hypothesis}}.
The prediction follows from the {{hypothesis}} alone, not from auxiliary assumptions.
Requires an {{observe}}d {{incongruity}}, not an argued one.
failure_modes: Auxiliary blame: the prediction rested on a background assumption, so the failed observation falsifies the bundle rather than the hypothesis.
Bad observation: the measurement was wrong, and a sound hypothesis is discarded.
